name: Teikoku Kaigun Koi Bojou ~Meiji Yokosuka Koushinkyoku~
original_name: 帝国海軍恋慕情 ～明治横須賀行進曲～
source:
The Meiji period...

Around the time the damages caused by the First Sino-Japanese War were beginning to heal, Mihagi Sonoo had graduated from a regular school. Unable to find employment, she found herself in poverty.

Then, an opportunity had arisen. Not far from her home was the Yokosuka Military Base, and they were looking to hire artists. Having learned of this, Sonoo headed for a job interview with the drawings she had made. However, while she was lost in the building, she accidentally witnessed the military band working as spies (they were in a meeting), and to top it off, she got caught doing so.

With the military band not wanting their secret to get leaked and with Sonoo looking for work, they came to an agreement: she became the military band's "artist-cum-spy apprentice" and became a member.

For a while, she was tasked with drawing posters and did some general work on the side. One day, her superior officer, Iyobe, summoned and ordered her to join the other band members to engage in actual spy missions.

And that was how the first mission of her life began.

[Translation of the official website story summary.]
translation:
明治时期…

大约在甲午战争造成的损失开始愈合的时候，美萩园男已经从普通学校毕业了。由于找不到工作，她发现自己陷入贫困。

然后，一个机会出现了。离她家不远的是横须贺军事​​基地，他们正在寻找艺术家。得知此事后，园野带着自己画的图纸前往面试。然而，当她在大楼里迷路时，她无意中目睹了军乐队充当间谍（他们正在开会），最糟糕的是，她这样做被抓了。

由于军乐队不想让他们的秘密被泄露，而Sonoo也在寻找工作，他们达成了一项协议：她成为军乐队的“艺术家兼间谍学徒”并成为一名成员。

有一段时间，她的任务是画海报，并兼职做一些一般工作。有一天，她的上级伊约部召唤并命令她与其他乐队成员一起执行真正的间谍任务。

就这样，她人生的第一个使命开始了。

【官网故事概要翻译。】
